title: azarolus crataegoides var. piriformis
intro: Azarolus crataegoides var. piriformis, commonly known as Higo or Chinese hawthorn, is a type of plant in the rose family that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Azarolus crataegoides var. piriformis include its ability to support cardiovascular health, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant, reducing oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which have been used to treat various conditions such as diarrhea, dyspepsia, and fever. Azarolus crataegoides var. piriformis contains bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
